text:
The following MCL Visual Guide is based on MCL App UI, the following is not repeatable
through MCL Web UI.
Main Navigation (Markets)→ …
LEVEL 1 – MENU NAVIGATION PAGE
[Screen Title]: Markets Overview
[Parent Screen]: None
[Child Screen]: Tasks Overview
Description:
After logging into the MCL App, users are directed to the Markets screen.
Users can access Markets to complete checklist/tasks or move onto different functions of
the app via icons highlighted in the red box.
⟦img:visual-guide-tasks-mcl-app_p1_i1⟧

Bottom Navigation Bar
The bottom menu provides quick access to core app functions:
Icon
Function
Checklist Icon
(List)
Opens the store overview (selecting a store will open checklist
overview)
Book Icon
Access checklist reports on the device
Clock Icon
Access tasks overview on the device
User Icon
Opens app configuration
Visible Interface Elements
Market List
•
Displays all accessible markets (e.g., Market 1, Market 2, Schulungsmarkt, etc.)
•
Each row represents one store
•
Tapping a market opens its checklist overview
Function
The Markets screen is the central entry point of the mobile app.
Users select a market to begin executing checklists.
→ Next Navigation Step
Select the clock icon to open the tasks overview.
LEVEL 2 – Markets Overview-> Tasks Overview

[Screen Title]: Tasks Overview
[Parent Screen]: Markets Overview
[Child Screen]: Searching or Creating new tasks
Description
The Tasks screen serves as the central task management area within the app.
From this screen, users can:
•
View created tasks
•
Search for existing tasks
•
Create new tasks
Visible Interface Elements
⟦img:visual-guide-tasks-mcl-app_p3_i1⟧

Element
Description
Filter Icon (Top Left)
Opens task search and filtering options
Plus Icon (Top Right)
Opens the Create Task screen
Task List Area
Displays stored tasks
Bottom Navigation Bar Provides access to other app modules
Function
This screen acts as the entry point for all task-related actions within the mobile app.
→ Next Navigation Options
•
Tap the Filter icon to search tasks
•
Tap the Plus icon to create a new task
LEVEL 3A– SEARCH TASKS
[Screen Title]: Tasks (Search View)
[Parent Screen]: Tasks Overview
[Child Screen]: Filtered Task Overview

Description
The Task Search screen allows users to filter and locate tasks based on defined criteria.
Users can narrow results using:
•
Date range
•
Task Timing (Due / Created / Started): Determines which task date is used for the
selected date range — the due date, the start date, or the creation date.
•
Market
•
Assigned user
•
Status
⟦img:visual-guide-tasks-mcl-app_p5_i1⟧

Visible Interface Elements
Element
Description
From Date Selector
Start date for filtering
To Date Selector
End date for filtering
Due / Create / Start
Defines which date type is filtered
Market Field
Filter tasks by specific market
Assigned To Field
Filter by responsible user
Status Field
Filter by task status
Search Button
Executes the task search
Function
Allows structured filtering to locate specific tasks across markets and users.
→ Next Navigation Step
Creating new tasks
LEVEL 3B – CREATE TASK
[Screen Title]: Task creation
[Parent Screen]: Tasks Overview
[Child Screen]: Task Overview

Description
The Create Task screen allows users to manually generate a new task within the app.
Tasks need to be assigned to a market and optionally to a user. Not selecting a user
redirects the task to default user (user who is assigned to these tasks as default).
Visible Interface Elements
Element
Description
Market
Select the store the task belongs to
⟦img:visual-guide-tasks-mcl-app_p7_i1⟧

Element
Description
Assigned To
Select responsible user (optional)
Start Date
Define when the task becomes active (optional)
Due Date
Define deadline for completion (optional)
Task Description Field
Enter task details (text or voice input supported)
Mandatory if there is no photo
Photo/Comment Toggle
User must attach photo or comment when working on the
task
Photo Upload Area
Capture or attach photo evidence
Mandatory is there is no task description
Add Button
Saves and creates the task
LEVEL 3C – Task Closing
[Screen Title]: Task Closing
[Parent Screen]: Tasks Overview
[Child Screen]: Task Overview
Task Closing
Tasks can be marked as completed directly within the app. There are two ways to close a
task:

1. Swipe to Close
Users can quickly complete a task by swiping the task entry in the task list.
This action immediately marks the task as completed.
This method can only be used for tasks that do not require additional documentation as
photo or comment submission.
⟦img:visual-guide-tasks-mcl-app_p9_i1⟧

2. Close with Notes
If additional context is required, users can open the task and add notes before closing it.
This is the only option to close a task when photo and comment are mandatory.
This allows the user to document:
•
Actions taken
•
Observations
•
Supporting information
Photos can also be attached if evidence of completion is required.
Notes can also be used to leave a note to document the current state and taken action
regarding the task, not only to complete a task.
⟦img:visual-guide-tasks-mcl-app_p10_i1⟧
⟦img:visual-guide-tasks-mcl-app_p10_i2⟧

Behavior
•
Tasks may be assigned to:
o A specific user
o A market (if no individual is selected)
•
Tasks assigned to “All” or without a responsible person follow store-level
assignment rules (if configured).
•
Created tasks will appear in task lists and synchronize with the web dashboard.
Function
Enables users to manually document corrective actions or follow-up items directly within
the app.

The following MCL Visual Guide is based on MCL Web UI, the following is not repeatable
through MCL APP UI.
Main Menu → Task Overview (Web interface)→ To Do List/New Task (Web interface)
LEVEL 1 – MENU NAVIGATION PAGE
[Screen Title]: Main Navigation Menu
[Parent Screen]: None
[Child Screen]: Task Overview
Description:
When users log in, they are taken directly to the MCL Dashboard. From the navigation
panel on the right (highlighted in the red box), they can access all management and
analysis modules of the MCL system.
Users with a smaller screen, will only see the MCL Dashboard without Navigation menu
which can be accessed clicking the hamburger icon (three horizontal lines) in the top-left
corner of the screen.
⟦img:mcl-visual-guide-tasks_p1_i1⟧

Depending on the user’s role, certain dashboard elements and menu sections may be
partially available or completely restricted.
Visible Elements (Left Panel):
1. Dashboard – Displays overall store performances statistics and charts.
2. Company – Manage company-level information (global conﬁguration) and create
tags.
⟦img:mcl-visual-guide-tasks_p2_i1⟧
⟦img:mcl-visual-guide-tasks_p2_i2⟧

3. Markets – Manage stores (create, delete, edit) and their departments, and connect
store tags to stores.
4. Departments – Manage store departments that appear in checklists.
5. Security – Manage users, access permissions and roles.
6. Questions – View, create, or manage questions used in checklists.
7. Checklists – Open the checklist management to create or manage checklists.
8. Reports – Access ad hoc checklist reports (pdf) and generate canned reports (Excel)
9. Data Analysis – Analyze checklist results and compare checklist ratings across
markets, departments, and users.
10. Tasks – View, edit, and assign tasks.
11. Photo Management – Browse and manage uploaded checklist photos.
Header Icons (Top Right):

Notiﬁcation Bell – Currently, no functionality.

Help (“?”) – Opens user documentation or quick help.

Lock Icon – Used to enter lockscreen mode.
Function:
This menu is the root navigation point of MCL Web.
Each item opens a dedicated conﬁguration area.
For this process ﬂow, the next step will focus on Checklists.
→ Next Navigation Step:
Select “Tasks” from the menu page to open the Tasks Overview.
LEVEL 2 – TASKS SUB-MENU
[Screen Title]: Tasks
[Parent Screen]: Main Navigation Menu
[Child Screen]: To Do List / New Task

Description:
Selecting Tasks expands two sub-options:
1. To Do List – View, ﬁlter, edit, complete, or delete tasks.
2. New Task – Create a new task.
Visible Interface Elements:

To Do List

New Task
Function:
Users choose whether they want to manage existing tasks or create a new one.
→ Next Navigation Step:
Select To Do List to view/manage tasks or New Task to create one.
LEVEL 3A – TO DO LIST
[Screen Title]: Tasks – To Do List
[Parent Screen]: Tasks Sub-Menu
[Child Screen]: None
⟦img:mcl-visual-guide-tasks_p4_i1⟧

Description:
This screen displays all tasks linked to the selected market and provides ﬁltering tools, task
editing, task completion/deletion.
A) Filter Buttons (Top)
Filters:

Market Selector → Only tasks from that market are shown

Status Buttons (3 Blocks):
Block
Meaning
Button Actions
Status: All Tasks
Shows all tasks system-wide for the
selected market
Open / Completed /
Missed
Status: Tasks from
me
Tasks created by the logged-in user
Open / Completed /
Missed
Status: Tasks for
me
Tasks assigned to the logged-in user
Open / Completed /
Missed
Delete Tasks Button:
Bulk delete tasks selected via checkboxes in the table.
⟦img:mcl-visual-guide-tasks_p5_i1⟧

B) Task Table (Main Section)
Below is a table explaining each column in the screenshot.
Column
Meaning / Function
Task
Task ID + name (clicking does not open it).
Photograph
Icon appears if a photo is attached to the task.
Clicking does open attached photo in a pop up.
PDF
Icon appears if a PDF is attached.
Clicking does open attached PDF in another browser window.
Edit Task (Pencil
Icon)
Opens the task for editing.
Checklist
Shows in which checklist the task was generated in (empty cell =
stand alone task).
Start Date
Starting date for when task will start.
Due Date
Deadline for completing the task.
Date Created
When the task was originally created.
Status
Not started / In progress / Completed.
Assigned by
Person who created/assigned the task.
Assigned to
User responsible for completing the task.
Notes
Eye icon = view existing notes; “+” icon = add note; complete task
within note.
Delete
Trash icon = delete task.
Checkboxes
Used for bulk deletion via Delete tasks button.

C) Function:
From the To Do List users can:

Review all tasks

Filter tasks by market, creator, assignee, checklist, start date, due date, creation
date, and status.

Edit task descriptions, users, attachments, and start/due dates

Add notes/ complete tasks

Delete tasks individually or in bulk
LEVEL 3B – NEW TASK
[Screen Title]: New Task
[Parent Screen]: Tasks Sub-Menu
[Child Screen]: None
⟦img:mcl-visual-guide-tasks_p7_i1⟧

Description:
This screen allows users to create new tasks manually, assign them to markets and users,
and add required details or attachments.
A) Task Information Section
Fields:

Market (required)

Description (required)

Start/Due Date

Photo/comment required checkbox
Buttons:

Markets → shows list of markets the task assignees are in

Users → shows list of users the task is assigned to.
B) Photo / Attachment Section
Users can add:

Photo attachments (optional and only 1 can be attached)

PDF attachments (optional and only 1 can be attached)
⟦img:mcl-visual-guide-tasks_p8_i1⟧

These will appear in the task record and in the mobile app.
C) User Assignment Section
Once you select a store, a  list of all users appears with:

Checkbox

Name

Role
Users selected here will receive the task.
Buttons (Top-Right):

Send – saves and distributes the task

Go Back – returns to the task list without saving
Function:
The New Task screen is used for:

Creating store-speciﬁc tasks

Assigning corrective actions after checklist ﬁndings

Setting deadlines

Providing additional documentation (photos/PDFs)

Distributing tasks to multiple users at once

Create newsletters for all stores.
